origin: The observed single proposal on development chose the failed residual unchanged (commit 9a8599f). This separate prospective check tests the effect of excluding previously failed configurations and requiring a strict physical result.
observed_arm: Use only failures of the learned configuration in three development starts. One independent real provider proposal per round, up to three new candidate physics evaluations with source-bound receipts. Record failures and physical results. A previously tested, strictly failed configuration cannot be adopted.
without_observation: Same menu, model, tried baseline and physics budget; omit initial measured failure observations. Report both choice and outcome.
selection_gate: Only a new candidate with strict whole mission success on all three development cases and zero body collision may be adopted. If no qualified proposal, retain the failed baseline for the intention-to-treat comparison.
test_gate: Publish both choices and provider output before revealing the twelve cases. Run all six physically distinct controls once per held-out case.
comparisons: each post-fix arm vs unchanged learned
each post-fix arm vs its observed single-proposal predecessor and actual no-observation comparator
positive_repair_criterion: At least 0.25 absolute gain in paired strict full mission success versus the unchanged learned controller and no higher body collision fraction. Identical candidate IDs share results and imply zero difference.
attribution: Separate the effect of the validated workflow, the provider choice with observations, and the contribution of the physical policy. This is a follow-up designed after the single proposal on development, not a change to its result.
